text: I gotta give back. I respect the gods and the earth. Y'all niggas love Jack. They wonder why I rhyme like I'm walking on air. The ground can't hold me. The ground ain't there. And everybody talking like Bizzy don't care. Everybody like Bizzy don't dare. They wonder why I keep on going, not listening. Why he ain't shining. Why he ain't glistening. Everybody talking like Bizzy ain't sizzling. All y'all like Bizzy ain't getting it. This rap shit is all me. One in a million. But still, they acting like they don't feel me.
